proposal.rationale: Excluding the asset's current profile (hybrid-x25519-mlkem768) and the classical x25519 profile (below the hybrid-pqc security floor), the only remaining allowlisted, floor-compliant profile is tls13-mlkem768 (pqc class), implemented via liboqs-0.16.0, which the asset has. Among peers advertising the required kem:mlkem768 capability with known readiness, only peer-02 qualifies for this batch: peer-01 also advertises the capability but its notes explicitly instruct exclusion due to imminent decommissioning. Peers 03/06 only support classical x25519 and peers 04/05 only support x25519mlkem768 (not plain mlkem768), so none of them are ready for this target profile and remain unaffected on their current settings. This yields the maximum achievable ready-endpoint count (1) at the highest available security class (pqc) among eligible profiles. Please schedule within the approved change window and monitor handshake error rates for 30 minutes post-change per the change window note.
